title: fix(lint,metadata-protocol,metadata-core)!: os lint and the react-page props check refuse the retired list-view filterableFields by name, and its residue readers go
body:
Closes #24728
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What this does

`@objectstack/spec` 18 retired the list view's `filterableFields` with a `retiredKey()` tombstone (#24640), so `os validate` and `os build` refuse it at the parse. `os lint` never parses, and a react page's source is parsed against no list-view schema, so the lint package still treated the key as a live field position. This PR removes every residue reader on the card's list, and turns the two that judge authoring input into a refusal by name that carries the tombstone's prescription.

**`os lint` (list views).** `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` no longer walks `filterableFields` (it is gone from the severity map `POSITIONS` and the dotted-path map `DOTTED_AXIS`). Instead every list-view rung that still carries the key reports a new rule, `list-view-key-retired` (`error`, at `...filterableFields`), whatever the key names and whether or not the object binding resolves. Before, on a JSON/YAML/raw source, a valid name passed `os lint` silently and a stale one was reported as `list-view-field-unknown`. The prescription is READ from `ListViewSchema`'s tombstone description (`[REMOVED] ...`), never retyped: the message carries its verdict head, the hint its "Delete the key" sentence, cut by the existing `retiredKeyRemedy` helper, the way the permission-residue rule already does it. The rule id is exported from the package root as `LIST_VIEW_KEY_RETIRED` (the package's own `rule-id-barrel-exports` test requires it). The keys reported are one frozen list, `LIST_VIEW_RETIRED_KEYS_REPORTED = ['filterableFields']`: the retired keys this rule used to read as field positions.

**React-page props (done first, per triage).** `REACT_FIELD_SPECS.ListView.fields` no longer lists `filterableFields`. The ListView block now carries `retiredSchemaProps`, built from the same list and the same tombstone reader. Writing the prop is refused as `react-prop-retired` (`error`) with "is retired and no prop replaces it" plus the tombstone's verdict head and remedy. The old "covers the legacy filterableFields shorthand" test is replaced: a valid name and a stale name both get exactly one `react-prop-retired` and no `page-field-unknown`, the hint equals the remedy read from the tombstone, and a `userFilters` lit control is not refused.

**The other residue readers.**
- `validate-field-consumers.ts`: `filterableFields` leaves `BEHAVIOUR_SEGMENTS`.
- `rule-explanations.ts`: `os explain list-view-field-unknown` and `list-view-field-dotted` no longer name it as a checked position.
- `metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts`: the dead walk is deleted, folded into the `tabs` retirement comment beside it.
- `metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts`: `LIST_VIEW_NAME_LISTS.filterableFields` is deleted. A body that still carries the key now goes the unclassified way and fails closed. Measured with a one-off probe against `applyObjectSchemaMask` (caller may read `id` and `title`): a list view whose `filterableFields` names the denied `secret_score` is dropped whole, and one naming only `title` is served unchanged. Output: `{"b":{"label":"B","columns":["title"],"filterableFields":["title"]}}`. No denied name leaks.
- Fixtures: `objectql/src/metadata-diagnostics.test.ts` (the array-shaped-fields case now uses `userFilters.fields`) and the lint field-refs tests (`FULL_LIST_VIEW`, the per-position case table, the dotted filter-position case).

**The ratchet.** `RESIDUE` in `packages/spec/src/ui/view-list-filterable-fields-retirement.test.ts` is now empty. All four entries left in this PR. The new pin file `packages/lint/src/list-view-filterable-fields-retired.test.ts` authors the key as a key on purpose, so it joins `EXCLUDED` by name with its reason, beside the spec pin it twins. The walk's offender list is `[]` and its anti-vacuity floors still hold (38/38 tests pass).

## Classification (changeset `.changeset/24728-filterable-fields-residue.md`)

`@objectstack/lint` minor, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, `@objectstack/metadata-core` patch. **BREAKING (an authoring narrowing)**, shipped `minor` under the launch-window convention.

- **Narrowing.** The react-page props check is a member of the reference-integrity suite with its default runtime types, so it runs on `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` only, not on the page save door. A react page writing the ListView element's `filterableFields` prop used to pass all three commands whenever its names resolved. It is now refused. On list views, `os lint` now fails a raw source that `os validate` already refused.
- **Widening of the public surface.** A new exported rule-id constant, `LIST_VIEW_KEY_RETIRED`.
- So the line is `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. That follows the precedent of the two list-view door refusals that added an exported rule id (`list-view-object-outside-closure`, `list-view-object-unknown`). ⚠️ The claim's line read `Clause-②: no`. It was written before the rule id existed, and this PR carries the corrected line instead of copying it.
- **ADR-0087 disposition:** `not-required (already-registered view-list-filterable-fields-removed, list-view-filterable-fields-retired)`. The key's tombstone, D2 conversion and D3 entry already exist (from #24640, same unreleased major), and this PR adds no key, conversion or stored shape. The changeset carries the FROM → TO table and the one-line fix.

## Verification (final head `7077ebc775`, the merge of `origin/main` `81120caac8`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 151 files / 6994 tests passed. `typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`): pass.
- On `5c3a09b412` (before the merge, which touched neither package): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core test`: 18 files / 780 passed, plus typecheck. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 251 files / 20828 passed (3 files / 19 tests skipped), plus typecheck. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: pass, and `src/metadata-diagnostics.test.ts`: 10/10.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/view-list-filterable-fields-retirement.test.ts`: 38/38. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date" (spec built first).
- Gate families from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (92 commands): all 92 run on `7077ebc775`, each exit 0, and `--ran` reconciliation answered "92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Among them: `check:adr-0087-registration` ("ADR-0087 exemption (already-registered)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:nul-bytes` and `check:cross-package-test-inputs`.
- Reach through the `os lint` registry: `runAuthoringRules('lint', { normalized })` on an unparsed stack whose list view carries `filterableFields: ['status']` returns exactly one `list-view-key-retired` `error` at `views[0].list.filterableFields` (pinned in the new test file). A spawned `os lint` CLI run was NOT MEASURED: the CLI package was not built in this worktree.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts` comments (around lines 56, 272 and 300) still list `filterableFields` among the positions the field-refs member walks. They are stale prose outside this claim's file surface, and no behaviour depends on them. Carrier: none.
- The other `retiredKey()` tombstones on `ListViewSchema` (`pageName`, `tabs`, `responsive`, `performance`, `striped`, `bordered`, `virtualScroll`) are equally unjudged by `os lint` on a raw source and by the react-page props check. They were never field positions in this rule, so nothing here ever gave them a wrong answer. Whether the renderer still reads any of them as a react prop is NOT MEASURED. Extending to them is one entry each in `LIST_VIEW_RETIRED_KEYS_REPORTED`. Carrier: none.
- Open PR #24858 also edits `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` and `validate-list-view-field-refs.test.ts`. Whichever lands second merges `origin/main` and keeps both sides. No other open PR touches these files (read over all 13 open PRs' file lists).
- objectui is not touched. Its reader removal is the #24640 objectui follow-up.
